# Brux

> Speaker booking agency and LinkedIn management for keynote speakers. Flat monthly retainers from $500/month with 0% commission on speaking fees, niche-only event research, and live CRM visibility.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.brux.site/): Overview of Brux's speaker booking process, client proof, plans, and backstage team.
- [Services Overview](https://www.brux.site/services/): Integrated keynote booking, LinkedIn management, demo reels, press kits, and custom websites.
- [Speaker Booking](https://www.brux.site/services/booking/): Direct monthly outreach (60 to 160+ pitches/month) to conference organizers in your verified niche.
- [LinkedIn Management](https://www.brux.site/services/linkedin/): Executive LinkedIn positioning, ghostwritten authority posts, and organizer network expansion.
- [Speaker Content](https://www.brux.site/services/content/): Demo reels, one-sheet press kits, and edited keynote talk clips.
- [Speaker Website Design](https://www.brux.site/services/web-design/): Custom speaker websites with full brand direction from $1,100 one-time.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://www.brux.site/pricing/): Transparent breakdown of Founder ($500/mo), Foundation ($1,200/mo), Growth ($1,800/mo), and Complete ($2,500/mo).
- [Pricing Markdown](https://www.brux.site/pricing.md): Clean machine-readable pricing breakdown and plan rules.
- [About Brux](https://www.brux.site/about/): Mission, vision, why legacy speaker booking models fail, and leadership team.
- [Blog](https://www.brux.site/blog/): Field notes on what event organizers ask for and how paid keynotes get booked.
